Name: (AT) More Rabbits Than You'll Ever Need Alternative Textures Version (ORIGINAL BY HANNAHBUG)
Author: paicream
Description:
[b][size=3][center]
04/30/24 : [Steam Deck] Fixed an issue that prevented the pack from being loaded due to the file names being capitalized...(huh)[/center][/size][/b]

I do not claim ownership over Hannahbug's Artwork, make sure to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14484]visit and !!! Endorse the original mod !!![/url]

Made Hannahbug's texture pack work with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] (Required)


[b][u]Installation:[/u][/b]
Download
Place into [i]stardew valley/mods[/i] folder. The file is named "[AT] MRTYEN" (More Rabbits Than You'll Ever Need)
Unzip
Run the game through [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]


[u]Note:[/u]
There is one texture that is duplicated in both the rabbit and babyrabbit folders due to a file naming issue I had. This will show up in-game as two identical rabbit coats in the texture picking menu. Not really an issue (I might fix it in the future)
 
Enjoy!

Thanks to HannahBug for the beautiful artwork and to PeacefulEnd for the handy [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] Mod
